items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: You were with the first one he had the band. You were with Tisdun. That's right.

ctx.x: When you were with the Supreme Band, you didn't play with any other then? No. That's the only band out there. Let's see. Now, we've got to get these years straight in here, because you had so many of them. You got me there. Well, what about the time that the Depression came on? Who were you playing with then? When the Depression hit us? What year was that? 1929. That's right. I guess I was with the Supreme Band then. Still with the Supreme. No, I think you were. So you hadn't formed your own band up then?
